TestReshardingTombstonesSingleNode::test.description: Single node smp=2, table with gc_grace=10s and tombstone_gc immediate; inserts 100 keys, flushes, deletes all, flushes, sleeps past grace and forces a compaction on one shard (repeated insert+flush). Stops node, asserts some partition tombstones remain (dump_sstables, 'tombstone' key per partition), restarts with smp=4 and waits for 'Resharded.*ks1/cf1', asserts tombstones still present (resharding must not purge, scylla 8e47f61df7 / #6600), no key resurrected (assert_none per key, tools/assertions.py:153), then major compaction leaves 0 tombstones. Parametrized over 4 compaction strategies.

Bug: compaction_strategy param is dead - table/keyspace are pre-created (resharding_test.py:395-425) and c-s uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS (cassandra-stress SettingsSchema.java:166), so compaction(strategy=...) and replication(factor=rf) (resharding_test.py:429) are ignored: the 4 strategy params per node count run the identical scenario and 4-node runs use RF=1. Note: _remove_existent_ks guard for @flaky reruns is dead since f536aa78e0; ignore_msb silently changes 15->12 via default arg (resharding_test.py:63); counter1 still sets dclocal_read_repair_chance/read_repair_chance (Cassandra-legacy options). Note (class-level): _verify_number_of_data_files (resharding_test.py:79-93) only asserts an upper bound (`<=` before*reshard_to); the 'during' count (resharding_test.py:173,181) is taken after node.start(wait_for_binary_proto) when boot-time resharding is already done, so it duplicates the 'after' check; dead commented-out compactionstats code in _wait_for_resharding (resharding_test.py:108-121); STCS and ICS params now identical (scylla 5bf0c6ddac makes STCS an alias of ICS) and resharding is strategy-agnostic, so the 8-param matrix is mostly redundant; !tablets -> only runs in dtest-release-with-raft.

TestReshardingVariants::test_resharding_.description: Creates base table (id pk + 1 int col) and MV with PK (id, col) via TableManager/MaterializedViewManager, prefills 10000 rows, checks count(*) on both, restarts node1 with smp+1 (and ignore_msb 15->12 via default arg), asserts base sstable count <= before*smp, resharding logged, no log errors, per-key assert_one count==1 on base and MV (tools/assertions.py:135), count(*)==10000 on both, and assert_two_queries_equal at CL=ALL. Guards MV + base consistency across resharding.
